# clicky

- **Upstream:** https://github.com/farzaa/clicky
- **Commit:** `e71105ce091d71dff4d89cf5d8d37ea1df460961`
- **Licence:** MIT

## Why we vendor it

Clicky is the MIT open-source predecessor of heyclicky. We take its native voice and overlay plumbing. Its cloud voice stack (AssemblyAI, ElevenLabs, Cloudflare Worker) is **not** taken (`docs/product.md` §2).

| Upstream file | What we take | Belay destination | Feature |
|---|---|---|---|
| `leanring-buddy/GlobalPushToTalkShortcutMonitor.swift` | Global hold-to-talk key monitoring while other apps are in front | **Adapt** at `apps/mac/Belay/Voice/Hotkey.swift` | C1, A4 |
| `leanring-buddy/AppleSpeechTranscriptionProvider.swift` | On-device Apple speech recognition provider | **Adapt** at `apps/mac/Belay/Voice/SpeechToText.swift` | C1 |
| `leanring-buddy/BuddyTranscriptionProvider.swift` | The transcription-provider protocol the above implements | **Adapt** (keeps STT engines swappable) | C1 |
| `leanring-buddy/OverlayWindow.swift` | Transparent, click-through, full-screen overlay window | Reference for `apps/mac/Belay/MacBridge/Overlay.swift` (rope-to-window drawing) | A8, D1–D3 |

The upstream folder name `leanring-buddy` is kept as-is so paths match the pinned commit.

**Rules:** files here stay byte-identical to upstream. Adapted copies carry a header:
`// Adapted from Clicky (MIT), <upstream path> @ e71105ce. See third_party/clicky/.`
